task.description:
Design a fix for the flaky test TC-EXT-01-U08a in tests/unit/service_task_test.zig (GH #528 / ISS-0207). Root cause: (1) CaptureServer hardcodes TCP port 18181, a shared machine-wide resource that collides under concurrent zig build test runs / parallel workspace checkouts; (2) captured header fields (first_trace_id, first_trace_id_len, and idempotency/custom-header equivalents) are written by the CaptureServer background thread and read by the test thread at line 339 with no happens-before edge — defer server.join() runs at scope EXIT, after the assertions, so this is a data race by construction. Produce a Type E prose design (src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md) describing: (a) CaptureServer binding an ephemeral port (port 0) and exposing the actual bound port so the test can build url_template dynamically instead of hardcoding 18181; (b) a synchronisation mechanism (e.g. a std.Thread.ResetEvent or explicit join-before-assert) establishing a happens-before edge between the server thread finishing its capture and the test thread reading the captured fields, replacing the defer-at-scope-exit pattern. Do not write implementation code — prose design only, per templates/lego-catalog.md Type E.

REWORK 1:
- [BLOCKER] std.Thread.ResetEvent does not exist in this repo toolchain (zig 0.16.0). Use std.Io.Event (lib/std/Io.zig ~L1766-1875: wait(io)/set(io)/waitTimeout(io, timeout), acquire/release happens-before semantics; std.testing.io already available on both threads) instead. Replace every ResetEvent reference in the design.
- [MINOR] Port-readback accessor is hedged and does not match the real API (std.Io.net.Server exposes socket/options; bound port is at server.socket.address). Reference the real field.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers ephemeral port binding + dynamic url_template construction
Design covers a happens-before synchronisation primitive between CaptureServer thread and test assertions
Design explicitly states captured-header fields must not be read from the test thread while the server thread may still write them
No implementation code present in the design artefact
